prediction.profile_text: Margot Calder is an interior architect based in London who runs her own studio. She specializes mostly in residential projects with a bit of hospitality work too. A fun fact: she's really into sea swimming and does it all year round even during winter.

Gwendolyn A. Parr is a senior partner at Halstead and Parr in Sydney who has been working there for decades while winding down her career soon to retire. She's an interesting woman with about forty antique clocks she restores herself; her husband even banned any more from his collection.

Camille Boisvert is a competitive rower who trains at five in the morning before work. She recently became partner at Northgate Capital after being promoted from principal three weeks ago and has been working on growth equity deals.
